item.description: Five members of an airline cleaning company were killed after an Amazon-branded cargo plane overran the runway at Miami International Airport, striking the company’s van and a passenger SUV. The deceased victims are Rolando Aleman, 55, Yoel Rodriguez Naranjo, 53, Julio C. Pineda, 75, Carlos Acosta Fajardo, 53, and Javierkys Reyes Quevedo, 47, the Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office said. NBC News' George Solis reports on the latest details from the crash.

media:content.media:title: Authorities identify 5 victims from deadly cargo plane crash in Miami
